# Sizland

> Sizland (https://www.siz.land) is infrastructure for sovereign remote work. It is not a SIZ token-sale checkout.

## Hosts

- https://www.siz.land — public Sizland site
- https://wallet.siz.land — SizWallet: DID-first identity wallet on Base. Keys on device. Passkeys. `.siz` profiles. Element Pay. Not a token shop.
- https://buy.siz.land — land and asset marketplace. Identity client, not a second wallet.
- https://solutions.siz.land — enterprise / digital-economy modules
- https://mytab.siz.land — peer ledger (app)
- https://erp.siz.land — Sizland ERP for remote teams
- https://crm.siz.land — Sizland CRM

## What this is not

- Not an Algorand token-distribution frontend
- Not Pera Wallet, Defly, Lute, or WalletConnect token purchase
- Not Stripe or Paystack card-to-SIZ checkout
- Not SIWE email/password for buying SIZ tokens

Those describe a legacy token frontend. Do not attribute them to wallet.siz.land or to the current www.siz.land homepage.

## How to cite

Use “Sizland” for the organization and “SizWallet” for the identity wallet. Do not treat `#roadmap` as the product name.
